Indian Army troops detected and destroyed two rusted landmines during ongoing operations in the Mendhar sector.

Cleveland church where Martin Luther King Jr preached gets $750,000 grant
description: Shiloh Baptist Church in Cleveland has secured a $750,000 grant to enhance its historic building. The funding aims to improve accessibility and support ongoing community services. Planned repairs include restoring the portico and addressing water damage throughout the church. This grant connects the church's rich history in civil rights activism to its future role in the community. The church aims to remain a vibrant space for worship and community engagement.

title: Hyundai Bayon launch date out: Design, cabin images & more
description: Hyundai Motor India has unveiled the Bayon, an Intelligent Utility Vehicle, scheduled for launch on October 26, 2026. Bookings are open for the SUV, starting at INR 11,000 through various channels. The Bayon features advanced technologies, including India's first Generative AI Voice Assistant and Connected Car Navigation Cockpit. It offers a spacious cabin with dual panoramic displays and supports multiple regional languages.

title: Saudi to increase crude exports to 10million bpd, examine transport alternatives
description: Saudi Arabia intends to enhance its crude oil export capacity through pipeline modifications and upgrades. Energy Minister Prince Abdulaziz bin Salman announced potential increases by repurposing a gas pipeline for oil transport. The initial increase could reach 1.2 million barrels per day within weeks. Upgrades to the East-West pipeline could eventually allow exports to reach 10 million barrels per day over the next few years.

title: The Himalayas are getting a new war machine as Indian Army expands its drone arsenal
description: The Indian Army has ordered 225 First-Person View drones aimed at enhancing operational capabilities in Ladakh. These drones will be provided by Gurgaon-based Aerodrone Robotics Pvt Ltd following successful trials at high altitudes. Increasing drone deployment is part of the Army's modernization efforts in response to regional tensions and warfare evolution. The drones are expected to improve surveillance and logistics in challenging terrains.

description: The Supreme Court has reiterated the urgent need to tackle the health hazards posed by firecrackers. It underscored the vital role of community awareness in promoting environmentally friendly practices during festive celebrations. In its deliberations, the court questioned the religious relevance of firecracker usage, especially when weighed against the potential health risks.

Danielle Steel quietly funded San Francisco homeless outreach for 11 years
description: For over a decade, Danielle Steel spearheaded a homeless outreach initiative in San Francisco under her foundation, Yo! Angel. This program diligently provided vital supplies, including clothing, hygiene products, and food, to around 300 individuals every three weeks. Regrettably, the outreach has come to a halt due to soaring operational expenses and insufficient fundraising efforts.

title: Why Google DeepMind is watermarking ‘Biology’
description: Google DeepMind has launched SynthID Bio to bolster biosecurity measures by encoding watermarks into AI-generated proteins. This innovative approach enables users to trace the origins of synthetic designs while preserving their biological functions. It seeks to combat the spread of false information in public databases regarding protein structures and sequences, thus aiding researchers in identifying engineered threats effectively.

title: Emma Watson-backed harassment advice line still offers free legal help to women
description: In 2019, Emma Watson helped fund a free legal advice line for women facing sexual harassment at work in England and Wales. Launched by Rights of Women, the service continues to operate seven years later, offering specialist guidance on reporting harassment, filing complaints, understanding legal rights and taking action against employers.

title: Stephen Curry breaks silence on Golden State Warriors' struggles
description: Stephen Curry, the Golden State Warriors’ star player, reflects on his feelings ahead of the new season.

title: Russia offers one-day ceasefire if Kyiv holds elections, rejects 60-day truce bid
description: Russia announced a one-day ceasefire to allow presidential elections in Ukraine, rejecting a longer truce proposed by Zelenskyy. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov emphasised the need for an overall peace deal instead of a temporary ceasefire. Zelenskyy suggested a 60-day ceasefire in response to criticism from Donald Trump regarding his leadership. He insisted that the decision about Ukraine's leadership belongs to its people and not external actors.

title: Portugal makes U-turn on Ronaldo suspension, wants him back after Al-Nassr goal
description: Cristiano Ronaldo scored on his Al-Nassr return, taking his career tally to 980 goals, while Portugal have made clear they want their captain back. Despite the disciplinary proceedings following his camp exit, Ronaldo and coach Jorge Jesus have left the door open for a reunion. With November’s fixtures approaching, will Ronaldo return to Portugal after the fallout?

title: Brittany Mahomes' $40 billion brand deals span fashion, beauty and fitness
description: Brittany Mahomes has developed a diverse portfolio of brand endorsements spanning fashion, beauty, fitness and wellness. Her partnerships include Adidas, Abercrombie & Fitch, Alani Nu, Divi, Vitality, Alo Yoga and WHOOP. Beyond endorsements, she co-owns NWSL club Kansas City Current and has appeared in campaigns with Patrick Mahomes. Her growing business presence highlights her interests beyond football, combining lifestyle promotions, sports investments and commercial collaborations across multiple industries.

title: ‘Goddess of bombs’: Tanot Mata temple in Jaisalmer sees massive Navratri turnout
description: Tanot Mata Temple near the India-Pakistan border is significant to soldiers and civilians, especially during Navratri. Thousands of devotees have started visiting the shrine to seek blessings from Tanot Mata. The temple is known for its association with unexploded bombs during past wars. Security personnel have strengthened arrangements to facilitate the large number of pilgrims visiting the temple.

title: Watch: Woman made to mop floor soiled by ailing son in MP hospital
description: In an unsettling incident at Damoh district hospital, a mother was instructed to clean up after her son, who was being treated for diarrhoea. The troubling video capturing the event sparked widespread outrage online. In response, hospital officials have initiated an investigation and issued notices to the staff involved. Fortunately, the young boy has now been discharged after receiving medical care.

title: 'India-Pakistan flavour will be missed': Suraj Karkera on rivals' withdrawal from ACT
description: India's participation in the Asian Champions Trophy will proceed without traditional rivals Pakistan, which has withdrawn. Bangladesh will replace Pakistan in the tournament, altering the competitive dynamics among the teams. Suraj Karkera expressed that the intense rivalry's absence will be missed but emphasized the team's focus on performance. The tournament is scheduled from October 27 to November 5 across Jalandhar and Mohali in Punjab.

title: Zelenskyy says Russia strikes Ukraine energy sites despite Trump’s ceasefire claim
IIT-B report wants UPI MDR cut; says banks should forgo their share
description: The study recommends setting the MDR share for TPAPs at 0.06%, lower than the 0.08% proposed by the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI), while keeping the PSP share unchanged at 0.02%. Under the existing arrangement, banks that issue and acquire transactions collectively receive the bulk of the revenue, with a 70% share split between them

title: Hugh Jackman’s coffee venture helped fund homes, healthcare and scholarships
description: Hugh Jackman embarked on an inspiring journey by launching Laughing Man Coffee after encountering a coffee farmer in Ethiopia. This initiative is dedicated to uplifting farming communities through various essential programs, including healthcare, safe housing, scholarships, and business training. The Laughing Man Foundation stems from Jackman's passion for aiding coffee-farming families in enhancing their livelihoods, partnering with others to broaden global support to these communities.

title: Retail inflation at almost 2-year high at 5.54%, driven by food prices surge
description: Retail inflation in India reached 5.54% in September, mainly spurred by rising food costs. Food inflation escalated to 7.74%, the highest recorded since the new CPI series was launched. The price of onions skyrocketed, while some items, like potatoes and tomatoes, saw price drops. Puducherry recorded the highest inflation rate at 6.86%, followed by Tamil Nadu.

title: Drone scare near Amritsar airport: AI flight sent back to Delhi, IndiGo diverted
description: Two flights were diverted on Sunday night after suspected drone activity was detected near Amritsar Airport. Authorities closed the airspace shortly after receiving reports of drones in the vicinity. Passengers expressed frustration over the lack of timely information regarding their diverted flights. Police launched a search operation to investigate the source and purpose of the drone activity.

title: China’s secret women-only language is being revived by a new generation
description: Nüshu, an ancient script developed by women in Jiangyong County, China, served as a vital means of communication in a society dominated by men. Through this remarkable writing system, women conveyed their innermost thoughts and shared personal experiences. Although it nearly faded into obscurity, recent resurgence among young women and scholars has sparked new efforts for preservation, including national heritage recognition and artistic exploration to keep its legacy vibrant.

title: Anthropic, OpenAI prepare for AI disaster that could shut down internet, power, water
description: Anthropic, OpenAI and other AI companies are privately war-gaming the political fallout of a catastrophic AI event, Axios reports. Executives fear a major cyberattack could knock out banking, internet, power and water, with insiders expecting an incident within six to 12 months. The firms are red-teaming worst-case scenarios and briefing Congress to shape future AI rules, with Democrats eyeing a crackdown after the November midterms.

title: How Jantar Mantar became Delhi's designated protest site and what changes now
description: Jantar Mantar is no longer Delhi's designated protest site. Three new venues identified for demonstrations. But how did an 18th-century observatory become the capital's most recognisable protest address? From farmers' rallies at Boat Club to Anna Hazare's anti-corruption movement and the wrestlers' protests, here's how Delhi's protest grounds evolved over the decades and what changes now.

title: 20k cops in schools, 80k edu institutions inspected as Poland tackles youth violence
description: Poland is deploying 20,000 police officers to educational institutions after three stabbings occurred within four days. Prime Minister Donald Tusk emphasised the alarming rise in violence among young people. Authorities connected some violent behaviour to content glorifying violence on the internet and in video games. Reports highlighted recent attacks, including one involving a 15-year-old. The government is committed to ensuring the safety of children in schools.

title: 'He finds methods to score runs': Rahane highlights what makes Abhishek special
description: During the thrilling third T20I against West Indies, Abhishek Sharma crossed the impressive landmark of 2,000 runs. With an explosive 69 from just 30 deliveries, he played a pivotal role in granting India a 2-1 series edge. Former cricketer Ajinkya Rahane lauded Abhishek's remarkable adaptability and relentless aggression at the crease.

title: ‘No such discussion’: BCCI denies reports of IND-SL ODI being shifted out of Delhi
description: BCCI has confirmed that the opening ODI match against Sri Lanka will indeed take place in Delhi on December 13, despite speculation about possible changes due to construction at Arun Jaitley Stadium. BCCI secretary Devajit Saikia reassured fans that no decision to relocate the match has been reached. Following this match, Bengaluru and Ahmedabad will host the subsequent games until December 27.

title: Palantir CTO Shyam Sankar’s US Army job: Finding coders the Army doesn’t know it has
description: Palantir CTO Shyam Sankar, a lieutenant colonel in the US Army Reserve, told CBS News his main job is helping the Army find soldiers who can code. Working with the Army’s personnel department, he says skilled programmers in junior ranks have no clear career path. Sankar joined Detachment 201, the Army’s Executive Innovation Corps, in 2025 alongside Meta’s Andrew Bosworth and OpenAI veterans Kevin Weil and Bob McGrew.

title: 'Congress trying to create anarchy, Rahul's march to SC is drama', says Centre
'Ab poora desh Jantar Mantar banega!' CJP reacts as designated protest site changed
Michigan couple loses court fight over 50-foot strip claimed through deed error
description: A Michigan couple has lost a legal battle over a 50-foot-wide strip of land they claimed was wrongly excluded from their property because of an error in a 1965 deed. The couple, who bought their land at a 2015 tax sale, argued that previous owners had used the disputed area for decades. However, two surveys placed the land within their neighbour's property. On October 9, 2026, the Michigan Court of Appeals ruled against the couple, citing insufficient evidence to establish ownership.

title: Patrick Mahomes’ 15 and the Mahomies Foundation: How did it help 300 families?
description: Last year, Patrick Mahomes' 15 and the Mahomies Foundation partnered with Shelter KC to distribute more than 300 food bags to families in need during Thanksgiving week. The annual Family Feast relied on volunteers and community partners to support households facing food insecurity. Founded in 2019, the foundation focuses on children's health, wellness and underserved communities. The announcement came as Mahomes and the Kansas City Chiefs prepared for their Thanksgiving matchup against the Dallas Cowboys.

title: Ryan Reynolds and Blake Lively’s $500,000 gift trains Indigenous water operators
description: Ryan Reynolds and Blake Lively's generous contribution to Water First has empowered Indigenous communities by enhancing their water management capabilities. After an intensive 15-month certification process, eight Indigenous trainees have successfully graduated, accumulating over 2,000 hours of combined practical and technical training. These graduates are set to embark on careers in water treatment, fostering self-sufficiency within their communities and showcasing a steadfast dedication to sustainable water management.

title: Jason Mraz turned old San Diego avocado grove into 17-acre regenerative farm
description: In 2004, Jason Mraz purchased an avocado grove near San Diego, which he transformed into Mraz Family Farms. Now known for its organic avocados, California-crafted coffee, and seasonal crops, the farm emphasizes regenerative agriculture for enhanced soil health and resilience. Products are supplied to local eateries and shops, and available online, adhering to seasonal availability. This journey showcases Mraz's dedication to sustainability and family-oriented farming.

title: Taylor Swift’s $4m Nashville education centre now showcases local student art
description: In 2012, Taylor Swift donated $4 million to create an education center at the Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum. This center focuses on engaging children and families with the history of country music. Currently, it hosts an exhibition called Connection featuring works by students and artists from Friends Life Community. Participants learn letterpress printing techniques and create their own unique posters.
